v.s: By the sun and its brightness
v.c: By the sun and its brightness,

q: By the moon when it follows it
v.s: And [by] the moon when it follows it
v.c: and the moon as it follows it,

q: By the day when it illuminates
v.s: And [by] the day when it displays it
v.c: and the day as it unveils it,

q: By the night when it covers
v.s: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it
v.c: and the night as it conceals it!

q: By the sky and the One Who created it!
v.s: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
v.c: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it,

q: By the earth and the One Who spread it out!
v.s: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
v.c: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it!

q: By the soul and the One Who perfected it...
v.s: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
v.c: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it,

q: (so that it may choose the path it wishes to follow).
v.s: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
v.c: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it!

q: Undoubtedly, the one who purified it
(the soul from kufr, Shirk and all spiritual diseases)
v.s: He has succeeded who purifies it,
v.c: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul,

q: (by involving it in kufr, Shirk and sin)
v.s: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
v.c: and doomed is the one who corrupts it! Destruction of the People of Ṣâliḥ

v.s: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
v.c: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance,

v.s: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
v.c: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺.

q: warned them, “Do not interfere with the camel of Allaah
(the camel that Allaah created specially and which emerged from a rock)
v.s: And the messenger of God [i.e., Sālih] said to them, “[Do not harm] the she-camel of God or [prevent her from] her drink.”
v.c: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”

q: So their Rabb annihilated them because of their sins and made their destruction widespread
(so that none of them were spared).
v.s: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
v.c: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground.

q: of His actions. Because of His immense wisdom in everything He does and because of His great power, none can hold Him accountable for anything.
v.s: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
v.c: He has no fear of consequences.
